runs.text: Ireland, judged like Israel. Ready? Official report. Finding one: Dublin is a settlement. Vikings founded it in eight hundred and forty one. Give it back to Norway! Finding two: a religious state. The constitution opens in the name of the Most Holy Trinity. Most primary schools? About eighty eight percent are under Catholic patronage. Finding three: for sixty two years, the constitution claimed the whole island. Northern Ireland included. Voters changed it in nineteen ninety eight. Finding four: Saint Patrick drove out all the snakes. Not one left. Ethnic cleansing. Sounds ridiculous? Israel hears it every day. Ireland isn't a theocracy. Neither is Israel, where one in five citizens is Arab. Both have real problems. One standard. So, one more time.
